download_repo_snapshot: download all files from a Hugging Face model repository into the local cache directory
download_filtered_files: download only files matching specific patterns from a Hugging Face repository using allow_patterns
dry_run_download: perform a dry run to list files that would be downloaded without actually downloading them
download_to_local_dir: download repository files and replicate the file structure into a specified local directory
download_with_auth: download files from a private or gated Hugging Face repository using an authentication token
